pattern_explanation: Many words in both languages come from the same Latin roots, so their spelling stays close, but their meanings can drift apart over time. Words such as skill and possible match closely in meaning, while the verb meaning to intend is hidden behind a look-alike form that means something different.
false_friend_warning: A Portuguese speaker may assume that the English verb pretend means to intend, because the Portuguese verb for intend looks almost the same, but pretend means to act as if something is true, so it is a false friend.
